holderQuote: She was just Human. Just…Mihaela raised the wand as Ylawes lunged, shield raised. Falene, Salamani, casting. She said something that lingered in Ryoka’s ears.
effectQuote: All of the blinding speed of the electricity had been stolen away.

holderQuote: The wind blew. Mihaela went flying. She caught herself—
effectQuote: The wind dropped her, suddenly sapped of fury.
They became twin blurs so fast that the world vanished except for them.

holderQuote: Colth activated his next trump card.
